messages:
Maria (CS): Heads up — AzureLane onboarding: we've seen a 95th percentile tail latency bump on the embeddings route for their /embed endpoint in staging over the last 24h. Renewal touchpoint in ~3 weeks. Suggested plan: run an INT8 quant pilot on a canary, and split routing so critical user traffic hits a small dedicated pool. Thoughts?
Sam (ML): Can you paste the latency numbers and the model name? If it's KV-cache churn we might get a lot by tuning cache TTL or batching. INT8 for that embed model usually reduces cost ~2-3x but need quality checks.
Maria (CS): Quick numbers: p50 28ms, p95 430ms, p99 1.2s. Spikes correlate with batch size dropping to 1 after cache eviction. Memory pressure seen on the host too. Customer is on model: open-embed-7b-v2.
Arjun (Eng): @Maria (CS) I can provision a small dedicated pool (dedicated-2) and set a route predicate: header x-az-traffic=critical -> dedicated-2; default -> hosted-int8-canary. On dedicated I'll enable prefix/KV caching and continuous batching. Need go-ahead from CS + ML to proceed.
Sam (ML): I'll kick off INT8 regression tests on the candidate artifact. Plan: run embedding drift/check with their eval set; if cosine delta < 0.5% we greenlight. Also recommend kv_cache_ttl=30m and max_batch_delay=6ms for this workload.
Liz (SE): I'll draft a short customer note (plain-language) explaining the tradeoffs (latency vs tiny embedding variance) and the A/B checklist for PM signoff. Will include rollback plan and expected cost delta.
Paul (Renewals): Thanks — if we can get p95 stable under ~200ms within 7 days that materially reduces renewal risk. We can offer a one-week credit if they want faster rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy started for dedicated pool dedicated-2 (job id: dj-8743).
Maria (CS): Action items summary: 1) @Arjun provision route + enable caching (ETA: today) 2) @Sam run INT8 regression and share eval (ETA: 48h) 3) @Liz send customer note and A/B checklist (ETA: EOD) 4) @Paul update renewal flag in CRM. I'll follow up in next standup. :thumbsup:
